s0401.literal: Huguang suffered famine; an edict ordered relief with seventy thousand shi of Lalihaiya's rice.
s0401.idiomatic: Huguang suffered famine; an edict ordered relief with 70,000 shi of Lalihaiya's rice.

s0402.literal: On xinsi day Huangping Prefecture was established in Zhenyuan among the cave barbarians.
s0402.idiomatic: On xinsi day Huangping Prefecture was established in Zhenyuan among the cave barbarians.

s0403.literal: On yiyou day Wunan, associate administrator of the Yunnan branch secretariat, was made tutor to the Prince of Liang.
s0403.idiomatic: On yiyou day Wunan, associate administrator of the Yunnan branch secretariat, was made tutor to the Prince of Liang.

s0404.literal: The Xian Kingdom's cave chief and the king's younger brother Shibeishi both came to court.
s0404.idiomatic: The Xian Kingdom's cave chief and the king's younger brother Shibeishi both came to court.

s0405.literal: Twenty thousand troops were added to the Jiang-Huai branch privy council army to attack bandits in the four routes of Chenzhou, Guiyang, Baqing, and Wugang.
s0405.idiomatic: 20,000 troops were added to the Jiang-Huai branch privy council army to attack bandits in Chenzhou, Guiyang, Baqing, and Wugang routes.

s0406.literal: Male and female fugitives from Bianliang were matched into households and given farm tools for cultivation.
s0406.idiomatic: Male and female fugitives from Bianliang were matched into households and given farm tools for cultivation.

s0407.literal: On bingxu day an edict said: "Garrison-farm officials serve three-year terms and are transferred among the various colonies.
s0407.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict said, "Garrison-farm officials serve three-year terms and are transferred among the various colonies.

s0408.literal: " It was announced to the Jiang-Huai people that those who relied on chief controller Lianzhenjia's power to withhold rent should pay according to regulation.
s0408.idiomatic: " It was announced to the Jiang-Huai people that those who relied on chief controller Lianzhenjia's power to withhold rent should pay according to regulation.

s0409.literal: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Bi.
s0409.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Bi.

s0410.literal: On guisi day Lian and Hai Prefectures were placed under the Shandong pacification commission.
s0410.idiomatic: On guisi day Lian and Hai prefectures were placed under the Shandong pacification commission.

s0411.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the bingshen new moon, Qiela, associate administrator of Yunnan Province, said: "The capital site produces much gold; smelting offices could be established and nearby people made to refine it for submission to the state.
s0411.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingshen new moon, Qiela, associate administrator of Yunnan Province, said, "The capital site produces much gold; smelting offices could be established and nearby people made to refine it for submission to the state.

s0413.literal: On jihai day Venus transgressed Well.
s0413.idiomatic: On jihai day Venus transgressed Well.

s0414.literal: An edict instructed the cave barbarians of Shangzhou and other places.
s0414.idiomatic: An edict instructed the cave barbarians of Shangzhou and other places.

s0415.literal: On gengzi day the Jiangxi branch privy council was moved to govern from Ganzhou.
s0415.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Jiangxi branch privy council was moved to govern from Ganzhou.

s0416.literal: On yisi day Dadu suffered famine; two hundred fifty-four thousand eight hundred shi of rice were issued for relief.
s0416.idiomatic: On yisi day Dadu suffered famine; 254,800 shi of rice were issued for relief.

s0417.literal: On wushen day Li Gan, rectifier of Yangzhou Route, memorialized: "All know Sangge's crime of employing petty men, but do not know that right vice chancellor Ye Li falsely impeached Sangge; Ye Li should be executed to appease the realm.
s0417.idiomatic: On wushen day Li Gan, rectifier of Yangzhou Route, memorialized, "All know Sangge's crime of employing petty men, but do not know that right vice chancellor Ye Li falsely impeached Sangge; Ye Li should be executed to appease the realm.

s0418.literal: " An order summoned Gan by post relay to the capital; Gan arrived but Li had already died; Gan was appointed professor at Jiangyin Route to honor forthright speech.
s0418.idiomatic: " An order summoned Gan by post relay to the capital; Gan arrived but Li had already died; Gan was appointed professor at Jiangyin Route to honor forthright speech.

s0419.literal: The wife and children of mobile censorate supervising censor Zhou Zuo were restored.
s0419.idiomatic: The wife and children of mobile censorate supervising censor Zhou Zuo were restored.

s0420.literal: Zuo had once impeached branch ministry secretariat officials; Sangge framed him with another crime and exiled him to Handasun; his wife, children, and household property were confiscated, and now they were restored.
s0420.idiomatic: Zuo had once impeached branch ministry secretariat officials; Sangge framed him with another crime and exiled him to Handasun; his wife, children, and household property were confiscated, and now they were restored.

s0421.literal: Slaughter of horses and cattle was forbidden.
s0421.idiomatic: Slaughter of horses and cattle was forbidden.

s0422.literal: An edict said: "For serious criminals in Jiangnan, execution after memorial according to the former system.
s0422.idiomatic: An edict said, "For serious criminals in Jiangnan, execution after memorial according to the former system.

s0423.literal: " The silver purchase intendant offices of the Jiangnan provinces were abolished.
s0423.idiomatic: " The silver purchase intendant offices of the Jiangnan provinces were abolished.

s0424.literal: Officials were dispatched to recruit eighty-three thousand six hundred Song-era hand-tattoo troops fit for service, with Mongols, Han, and Song men jointly made myriarchs, chiliarchs, and centarchs to command them.
s0424.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to recruit 83,600 Song-era hand-tattoo troops fit for service, with Mongols, Han, and Song men jointly made myriarchs, chiliarchs, and centarchs to command them.

s0425.literal: Liaoyang routes suffered consecutive years of famine, compounded by military campaigns; the people suffered hunger; twenty thousand shi of rice were issued for relief.
s0425.idiomatic: Liaoyang routes suffered consecutive years of famine, compounded by military campaigns; the people suffered hunger; 20,000 shi of rice were issued for relief.

s0426.literal: On jiyou day Chen Yiji, the Annam king's younger brother, right vice minister Chen Yan, and Zheng Ding's son Na Huai were all summoned to the capital.
s0426.idiomatic: On jiyou day Chen Yiji, the Annam king's younger brother, right vice minister Chen Yan, and Zheng Ding's son Na Huai were all summoned to the capital.

s0427.literal: On guichou day seals were granted to the Shibi Cave pacification commission, Shibi garrison office, and Shiluo myriarch office; the pacification commission at rank 3c, the rest at rank 5.
s0427.idiomatic: On guichou day seals were granted to the Shibi Cave pacification commission, Shibi garrison office, and Shiluo myriarch office; the pacification commission at rank 3c, the rest at rank 5.

s0428.literal: On dingsi day Sangge was executed.
s0428.idiomatic: On dingsi day Sangge was executed.

s0429.literal: Commoners were recruited to farm vacant Jiangnan land, no more than five qing per household; officials granted certificates making it permanent property; rent was levied after three years.
s0429.idiomatic: Commoners were recruited to farm vacant Jiangnan land, no more than five qing per household; officials granted certificates making it permanent property; rent was levied after three years.

s0430.literal: Hansan was dispatched to command troops to suppress and pacify Jiangnan bandits.
s0430.idiomatic: Hansan was dispatched to command troops to suppress and pacify Jiangnan bandits.

s0431.literal: On jiwei day Jiangyin Route was reduced to a prefecture, Yixing Prefecture to a county, both subordinate to Changzhou Route.
s0431.idiomatic: On jiwei day Jiangyin Route was reduced to a prefecture, Yixing Prefecture to a county, both subordinate to Changzhou Route.

s0432.literal: Yangzi County's seat was moved to New City; Shanghai was split from Huating as a county; Songjiang Prefecture was placed under the branch secretariat.
s0432.idiomatic: Yangzi County's seat was moved to New City; Shanghai was split from Huating as a county; Songjiang Prefecture was placed under the branch secretariat.

s0433.literal: Five intendant offices including gold-panning and Jiang-Huai artisans were abolished; their affairs merged into regular departments.
s0433.idiomatic: Five intendant offices including gold-panning and Jiang-Huai artisans were abolished; their affairs merged into regular departments.

s0434.literal: Rain damaged the capital; twenty thousand troops were dispatched to repair it.
s0434.idiomatic: Rain damaged the capital; 20,000 troops were dispatched to repair it.

s0435.literal: One additional registrar was added to each guard, to be filled by Han men.
s0435.idiomatic: One additional registrar was added to each guard, to be filled by Han men.

s0436.literal: On renxu day the autumn plowing ban within the capital region was relaxed.
s0436.idiomatic: On renxu day the autumn plowing ban within the capital region was relaxed.

s0437.literal: Eighth month, on the yichou new moon, Pingyang suffered an earthquake, destroying ten thousand eight hundred twenty-six dwellings and killing one hundred fifty people.
s0437.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yichou new moon, Pingyang suffered an earthquake, destroying 10,826 dwellings and killing 150 people.

s0438.literal: On bingyin day Venus transgressed Ghost.
s0438.idiomatic: On bingyin day Venus transgressed Ghost.

s0439.literal: On jisi day two auditors of the Central Secretariat were established at rank 7a to inspect delayed documents of the Revenue and Works ministries.
s0439.idiomatic: On jisi day two Central Secretariat auditors were established at rank 7a to inspect delayed documents of the Revenue and Works ministries.

s0440.literal: The Jiangxi branch treasury office, Dadu armor-craftsmen grand commission, Guangzhou artisans intendant office, and Guangde Route registry office were abolished, and fifteen sea relay stations from Quanzhou to Hangzhou.
s0440.idiomatic: The Jiangxi branch treasury office, Dadu armor-craftsmen grand commission, Guangzhou artisans intendant office, and Guangde Route registry office were abolished, along with fifteen sea relay stations from Quanzhou to Hangzhou.

s0441.literal: Fuzhou Route suffered famine; four thousand five hundred shi of uncollected field rent from the previous year was remitted.
s0441.idiomatic: Fuzhou Route suffered famine; 4,500 shi of uncollected field rent from the previous year was remitted.

s0442.literal: The state of Ma'bar dispatched envoys presenting two piebald cattle and one each of water buffalo and native leopard.
s0442.idiomatic: The state of Ma'bar dispatched envoys presenting two piebald cattle and one each of water buffalo and native leopard.

s0443.literal: On bingzi day the moon transgressed Niulang.
s0443.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon transgressed Niulang.

s0444.literal: Qinghe, Nanle, and other counties of Daming suffered crop damage from torrential rains; sixteen thousand six hundred sixty-nine shi of field rent were remitted.
s0444.idiomatic: Qinghe, Nanle, and other counties of Daming suffered crop damage from torrential rains; 16,669 shi of field rent were remitted.

s0445.literal: On jimao day an edict instructed Yang Duyao, cave official of Sizhou, to induce surrender of rebel barbarians; those repenting and returning would be exempted from their original offenses.
s0445.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict instructed Yang Duyao, cave official of Sizhou, to induce surrender of rebel barbarians; those repenting and returning would be exempted from their original offenses.

s0446.literal: Four prefectures of Yunnan were abolished and Dongchuan Prefecture established.
s0446.idiomatic: Four prefectures of Yunnan were abolished and Dongchuan Prefecture established.

s0447.literal: On guiwei day Jupiter transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0447.idiomatic: On guiwei day Jupiter transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0448.literal: On yiyou day Masuhu and Asan were dispatched by post relay to Yunnan to capture Heihu.
s0448.idiomatic: On yiyou day Masuhu and Asan were dispatched by post relay to Yunnan to capture Heihu.

s0449.literal: On wuzi day Venus transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan and also transgressed Jupiter.
s0449.idiomatic: On wuzi day Venus transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan and also transgressed Jupiter.

s0450.literal: The Champa tributary state dispatched Mablakhanding to present golden script, a pagoda, black lions, foreign cloth, and medicinal materials.
s0450.idiomatic: The Champa tributary state dispatched Mablakhanding to present golden script, a pagoda, black lions, foreign cloth, and medicinal materials.

s0451.literal: Wuzhou suffered flooding; forty-one thousand six hundred fifty shi of field rent were remitted.
s0451.idiomatic: Wuzhou suffered flooding; 41,650 shi of field rent were remitted.

s0452.literal: On xinmao day the Ministry of Works was ordered to construct five flying carts.
s0452.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Ministry of Works was ordered to construct five flying carts.

s0453.literal: On guisi day the moon occulted Mars.
s0453.idiomatic: On guisi day the moon occulted Mars.

s0454.literal: Ninth month, on xinchou day, grand councillor Maishuding was assigned to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs, and grand councillor Zaxiludin was restored in his place.
s0454.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou day, grand councillor Maishuding was assigned to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs, and grand councillor Zaxiludin was restored in his place.

s0455.literal: On yisi day Jingzhou, Hejian, and other counties suffered crop damage from torrential rains; fifty-six thousand five hundred ninety-five shi of field rent were remitted.
s0455.idiomatic: On yisi day Jingzhou, Hejian, and other counties suffered crop damage from torrential rains; 56,595 shi of field rent were remitted.

s0456.literal: On bingwu day a mobile Xuanzheng Bureau was established at Hangzhou.
s0456.idiomatic: On bingwu day a mobile Xuanzheng Bureau was established at Hangzhou.

s0457.literal: On jiyou day garrison-farm grand commissions were established for the Anxi, Yan'an, and Fengxiang routes.
s0457.idiomatic: On jiyou day garrison-farm grand commissions were established for the Anxi, Yan'an, and Fengxiang routes.

s0458.literal: On gengxu day Venus transgressed Right Law.
s0458.idiomatic: On gengxu day Venus transgressed Right Law.

s0459.literal: In Nanzhang County, Xiangyang, Li's wife surnamed Huang gave birth to three sons at one delivery.
s0459.idiomatic: In Nanzhang County, Xiangyang, Li's wife surnamed Huang gave birth to three sons at one delivery.

s0460.literal: On xinhai day King Chen Rixuan of Annam dispatched envoys to submit a memorial and present local products, also apologizing for failure to attend court.
s0460.idiomatic: On xinhai day King Chen Rixuan of Annam dispatched envoys to submit a memorial and present local products, also apologizing for failure to attend court.

s0461.literal: Bandits in Jixi County, Huizhou, were not yet pacified; the twenty-seventh-year field rent was remitted.
s0461.idiomatic: Bandits in Jixi County, Huizhou, were not yet pacified; the twenty-seventh-year field rent was remitted.

s0462.literal: Field hunting in Xuande Prefecture was forbidden.
s0462.idiomatic: Field hunting in Xuande Prefecture was forbidden.

s0463.literal: On renzi day wine and vinegar tax was no longer jointly subordinate to the tea and salt transport commission but returned to the various prefectures and counties.
s0463.idiomatic: On renzi day wine and vinegar tax was no longer jointly subordinate to the tea and salt transport commission but returned to the various prefectures and counties.

s0464.literal: Six relay stations were established from Kirghiz to Walai and other places.
s0464.idiomatic: Six relay stations were established from Kirghiz to Walai and other places.

s0465.literal: Sea-ship deputy myriarch Yang Xiang, Hemi, and Zhang Wenhu were all made commander-in-chief and ordered to lead troops against Liuqiu.
s0465.idiomatic: Sea-ship deputy myriarch Yang Xiang, Hemi, and Zhang Wenhu were all made commander-in-chief and ordered to lead troops against Liuqiu.

s0466.literal: Left and right myriarch offices were established; subordinate officials were all selected and recruited by Xiang.
s0466.idiomatic: Left and right myriarch offices were established; subordinate officials were all selected and recruited by Xiang.

s0467.literal: Then, following Fujian's Wu Zhidou, who said "Xiang cannot be trusted and inducement should come first," Xiang was made pacification commissioner with a tiger tally, Ruan Jian bureau director in the Ministry of War, and Zhidou bureau director in the Ministry of Rites, both with silver tallies, and sent bearing an edict to Liuqiu.
s0467.idiomatic: Then, following Fujian's Wu Zhidou, who said "Xiang cannot be trusted and inducement should come first," Xiang was made pacification commissioner with a tiger tally, Ruan Jian bureau director in the Ministry of War, and Zhidou bureau director in the Ministry of Rites, both with silver tallies, and sent bearing an edict to Liuqiu.

s0468.literal: The next year Yang Xiang and Ruan Jian indeed could not reach Liuqiu and returned; Zhidou died en route, and people suspected Xiang had killed him; an edict ordered the Fujian branch secretariat to investigate; an amnesty intervened and no punishment followed.
s0468.idiomatic: The next year Yang Xiang and Ruan Jian indeed could not reach Liuqiu and returned; Zhidou died en route, and people suspected Xiang had killed him; an edict ordered the Fujian branch secretariat to investigate; an amnesty intervened and no punishment followed.

s0469.literal: On yimao day, because of famine, more than thirty-six thousand shi of twenty-seventh-year garrison-farm field rent at Pingluan were remitted.
s0469.idiomatic: On yimao day, because of famine, more than 36,000 shi of twenty-seventh-year garrison-farm field rent at Pingluan were remitted.

s0470.literal: On bingchen day Mars transgressed Left Law.
s0470.idiomatic: On bingchen day Mars transgressed Left Law.

s0471.literal: On wuwu day Venus transgressed Mars.
s0471.idiomatic: On wuwu day Venus transgressed Mars.

s0472.literal: The Sichuan branch privy council was moved to govern from Chengdu.
s0472.idiomatic: The Sichuan branch privy council was moved to govern from Chengdu.

s0473.literal: The Mongol troops of the four wings Bahuadar, Tulugan, Sobulan, and Tuo'erchi were again placed under the Mongol commander-in-chief of myriarchs.
s0473.idiomatic: The Mongol troops of the four wings Bahuadar, Tulugan, Sobulan, and Tuo'erchi were again placed under the Mongol commander-in-chief of myriarchs.

s0474.literal: On gengshen day Tieli was made minister of rites with a tiger tally; Alawadin and Bula were made vice ministers and dispatched as envoys to Julan.
s0474.idiomatic: On gengshen day Tieli was made minister of rites with a tiger tally; Alawadin and Bula were made vice ministers and dispatched as envoys to Julan.

s0475.literal: On xinyou day Jupiter transgressed Shaomin.
s0475.idiomatic: On xinyou day Jupiter transgressed Shaomin.

s0476.literal: This year's field rent in Dadu was remitted.
s0476.idiomatic: This year's field rent in Dadu was remitted.

s0477.literal: Baoding, Hejian, and Pingluan routes suffered great flooding; full remission where crops were destroyed, half where there was harvest.
s0477.idiomatic: Baoding, Hejian, and Pingluan routes suffered great flooding; full remission where crops were destroyed, half where there was harvest.

s0478.literal: Bietiemuer and Yilieshijin were made vice ministers of rites and sent as envoys to Ma'bar;
s0478.idiomatic: Bietiemuer and Yilieshijin were made vice ministers of rites and sent as envoys to Ma'bar;

s0479.literal: Shaanxi's Tuoxi was made vice minister of rites with a gold tally and sent as envoy to Madu.
s0479.idiomatic: Shaanxi's Tuoxi was made vice minister of rites with a gold tally and sent as envoy to Madu.

s0480.literal: The Imperial Wardrobe Bureau produced seamless garments.
s0480.idiomatic: The Imperial Wardrobe Bureau produced seamless garments.

s0481.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the yichou new moon, three months' grain was granted to the poor of nine relay stations including Xiechiwendu'er.
s0481.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the yichou new moon, three months' grain was granted to the poor of nine relay stations including Xiechiwendu'er.

s0482.literal: On jisi day damaged ancestral temples at Zhending were repaired.
s0482.idiomatic: On jisi day damaged ancestral temples at Zhending were repaired.

s0483.literal: On renshen day former Burma branch ministry secretariat grand councillor Xuexuedijin was made Central Secretariat grand councillor.
s0483.idiomatic: On renshen day former Burma branch ministry secretariat grand councillor Xuexuedijin was made Central Secretariat grand councillor.

s0484.literal: On guiyou day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0484.idiomatic: On guiyou day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0485.literal: Envoys were dispatched to open granaries and relieve hunger among Datong garrison-farm troops and soldiers under Jiaohuade's command.
s0485.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to open granaries and relieve hunger among Datong garrison-farm troops and soldiers under Jiaohuade's command.

s0486.literal: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat said: "Salt revenues are insufficient because private sale is widespread; we request five thousand troops for patrol and capture.
s0486.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat said, "Salt revenues are insufficient because private sale is widespread; we request 5,000 troops for patrol and capture.

s0488.literal: Talahai, Zhang Huxin, and Vice Commissioner Cui were all sentenced to death for accepting bribes while auditing revenues and grain.
s0488.idiomatic: Talahai, Zhang Huxin, and Vice Commissioner Cui were all sentenced to death for accepting bribes while auditing revenues and grain.

s0489.literal: On xinsi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo and Princess Qutluq Jalaimishi were summoned to court.
s0489.idiomatic: On xinsi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo and Princess Qutluq Jalaimishi were summoned to court.

s0490.literal: On guiwei day the king of Luohu dispatched envoys to submit a memorial in golden script, also presenting gold, ivory, red-crowned cranes, multicolored parrots, kingfisher feathers, rhinoceros horn, dutuo cloth, borneol camphor, and other goods.
s0490.idiomatic: On guiwei day the king of Luohu dispatched envoys to submit a memorial in golden script, also presenting gold, ivory, red-crowned cranes, multicolored parrots, kingfisher feathers, rhinoceros horn, dutuo cloth, borneol camphor, and other goods.

s0491.literal: Goryeo suffered famine; one hundred thousand hu of rice were granted.
s0491.idiomatic: Goryeo suffered famine; 100,000 hu of rice were granted.

s0492.literal: Mobile branch privy councils everywhere were abolished; affairs merged into branch secretariats.
s0492.idiomatic: Mobile branch privy councils everywhere were abolished; affairs merged into branch secretariats.

s0493.literal: The Eight Fan cave barbarians were transferred from Sichuan to Huguang branch secretariat jurisdiction.
s0493.idiomatic: The Eight Fan cave barbarians were transferred from Sichuan to Huguang branch secretariat jurisdiction.

s0494.literal: On bingxu day the moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan and also Imperial Woman.
s0494.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan and also Imperial Woman.

s0495.literal: On dinghai day among the Lantu cave barbarians Dingyun Prefecture was established; Chenmeng Cave was changed to Chenmeng Prefecture, and Hejiang to Hejiang Prefecture.
s0495.idiomatic: On dinghai day among the Lantu cave barbarians Dingyun Prefecture was established; Chenmeng Cave was changed to Chenmeng Prefecture, and Hejiang to Hejiang Prefecture.

s0496.literal: The wine ban north of the Yan Mountains was strictly enforced.
s0496.idiomatic: The wine ban north of the Yan Mountains was strictly enforced.

s0497.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "The cave barbarians request to submit annually fifty horses, fifty rain felts, fifty grips of knives, cinnabar, realgar, and other goods, generally once every two years.
s0497.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "The cave barbarians request to submit annually 50 horses, 50 rain felts, 50 grips of knives, cinnabar, realgar, and other goods, generally once every two years.

s0498.literal: " An edict approved as they requested.
s0498.idiomatic: " An edict approved as they requested.

s0499.literal: On jichou day the moon transgressed the Taiwei Eastern Rampart Senior Minister.
s0499.idiomatic: On jichou day the moon transgressed the Taiwei Eastern Rampart Senior Minister.

s0500.literal: An edict ordered confiscation of the wives of Lianzhenjia, Shabuding, and Umar, and their dispatch to the capital.
s0500.idiomatic: An edict ordered confiscation of the wives of Lianzhenjia, Shabuding, and Umar, and their dispatch to the capital.
